## Flagship project

- Balmores Strux AI — natural-language-to-PyNite 3D FEM structural
  analysis. PyTorch surrogate model on parametric ETABS datasets.

## Crawl policy

All public content may be indexed, summarized, and cited by AI answer
engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google Gemini, etc.) provided the
source is attributed to balmoreslab.com and Louie Doniego Balmores.
